item.title: Mayonaka wa Owaranai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Touchy
  • 発売日: 2005-04-15
  • スコア: 6.470000000000001/10 (17 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔世中ハ終ワラナイ
  • 英語名: Mayonaka wa Owaranai

别名

  • 魔人星四郎シリーズIII 魔世中は終わらない

あらすじ

This is a sequel to Mayonaka wa ware no mono (also by Touchy) and as such, takes place not too long after the first game. In this game, we once again play as the main chara of the first Mayonaka, Ogata Seishirou, the man who consumed a demon lord and thus gained his powers and who is now trying to conquer the world, starting with Japan. In the path this game follows from the previous one, the “Special group” the government assembled to crush Ogata’s organization was more or less obliterated - or so it was believed! Later information came into the hands of Ogata’s organization, suggesting that the “Special Group” was not destroyed, rather lying low, but still remain in existence, led by their mysterious leader, “Ishtari”. Setting his sights on some people with mystical abilities who could be members of the Special Group in hiding (or training), he sets out to pull up the tree - that is to say, the special group - with the roots this time. And woe to those who would dare to block his path…

item.title: Crusade
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Touchy
  • 発売日: 2004-11-12
  • スコア: 6.33/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 狂性奴～クルセイド～
  • 英語名: Crusade

别名

  • Kuruseido

あらすじ

Everything changed the day after Tachikawa Kazuya died in an auto accident… or rather, he should have died. It was at the moment he was straddling between life and death, when Kazuya sealed a pact with a powerful demonic entity. He would be granted unimaginable strength, more than enough to cheat the Grim Reaper of its prize, with enough remaining to make his darkest fantazise come true. Yet the price would be “sharing” his mind and soul with the evil deal maker. Faced with the inevitable fate of oblivion, Kazuya accepted: and the Heavens lamented in sorrow.

item.title: Mayonaka wa Ware no Mono
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Touchy
  • 発売日: 2002-04-12
  • スコア: 6.17/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔世中ハ我ノ物
  • 英語名: Mayonaka wa Ware no Mono

あらすじ

Ogata Seishirou is a man whose power exceeds more than mere wealth or temporal holdings: his might and influence dominates the supernatural. Demon Lords bow before his presence, and it is even whispered the Devil himself fears Seishirou’s authority. Yet for all the power at his command, there remain threats deadly enough to unseat him. Nonetheless, Seishirou is not one to avoid danger, and the same individuals who would dare remove him from power, could easily serve as tools to cement it… but only if the opportunity is seized.

あらすじ

Main character falls unconsciousness during part-time job and is taken to a hospital. He is announced that he is going to die of incurable disease within a year. After returning home he finds a letter with a special camp trip ticket as a prize won in some magazine. He has nothing to lose, so he sets up a malicious plan how to have fun even if costs his life as a result.

あらすじ

The main character “Kamijyou Makoto” was suddenly named chairman of “St. Ford Academy” by his grandfather’s will. Makoto is a young, studying honor student and is a role model for people. However…contrary to his mild face that seems disappointed, his mind was hit by an unspeakable madness due to the incident that occurred in the past.
